title: Sapient
summary: Self-custody Chrome extension wallet for Tari Ootle. November 11, 2026: the official Chrome Web Store offers version 0.9.6, updated November 10. Current source includes mainnet support, but this review did not install the extension or independently execute a wallet send. Use the official store for the current available extension: GitHub latest release still points to the older 0.4.2 ZIP. The retained recording is historical source footage.
cardSummary: Get the current Sapient browser extension to manage Ootle accounts, private transfers and app approvals.
